camera.reason: 108MP main camera with OIS plus a 5MP ultrawide.

performance.reason: Snapdragon 6s 4G Gen 2 is smooth in daily use and light gaming.

battery.reason: 7,000mAh with 45W charging lasts close to two days.

display.reason: 6.77 inch FHD+ AMOLED at 120Hz with 1,300 nits high brightness and a 3,000 nit peak.

build.reason: Plastic frame and back with IP65 and a 2m drop rating.

software.reason: HONOR has not published an X8d policy; 2 Android upgrades is an assumption.

value.reason: Combines AMOLED, an OIS camera and 7,000mAh, but at 78,000 for 256GB it sits at the top of the bracket.

availability.reason: In stock in three colours at PriceOye with official HONOR warranty.

notes: Pakistan sells only the 8GB 256GB. WhatMobile shows the official price as 84,999; PriceOye sells it at 77,999. First listed in December 2025; most official launches were in 2026. Only PriceOye was checked for stock. Update policy assumed.
